Evolve offers product design and development services from concept to production.

Evolve is a product design consulting firm with manufacturing and plastics expertise, specializing in world-class product development services and committed to creating successful innovative products and to helping industry leaders enhance their position in the global market.

Personal Welcome

Welcome to Evolve Design Solutions Inc., a product design consulting firm with manufacturing and plastics expertise, specializing in world-class product development services, and committed to helping industry leaders enhance their position in the global market.

Within this site, you will find a wealth of information conveying our capabilities, our processes, and most importantly, our philosophy; that creating great products is an accomplishment, achieved by clients and suppliers working together as strategic business partners.

If you are looking for a strategic business partner, one who shares your passion for excellence and your vision for creating a mutually beneficial relationship, we welcome the opportunity to speak with you.
Vision & Business Practices

Our goal is to establish a long term working relationship with you and your company. We practice a proven phased development process and typically work on a professional fee-for-service proposal basis or a design services retainer agreement.

Evolve Design Solutions is seeking, and is engaged in product development programs that will make a difference and improve your bottom line. We seek to partner on programs with companies and individuals where we will mutually share in the risks, rewards and success of our collaboration.
Our common goals and interest in the success of your program can create an extremely effective and prosperous relationship. Please call us to discuss how we can start working together.
We listen, collaborate and create…
Mission Statement
To help our clients build and maintain a competitive advantage through quick introduction of innovative, attractive and cost-effective world-class products.
Evolve Design Solutions exists as a professional service organization to improve or advance the position and interests of our clients.

We work together with our clients to create successful innovative new products in the marketplace with less time, less risk, less cost while improving our clients’ bottom line. We do so as consumer, environmental and manufacturing advocates; in the best interests of all.
Our Team

Evolve Design Solutions is composed of a team of experienced industrial designers and engineer associates which, over the years, have successfully developed products with varied manufacturing processes for the electronics, appliances, telecom, consumer, medical, sporting good and industrial markets. Our team’s multi-disciplinary expertise provides the basis for broad-thinking that leads to innovative concepts and production ready solutions.

Aldo Balatti, D.I.D., IDSA, SPE, SME
Principal & Founder

Aldo Balatti, D.I.D., IDSA, SPE, SME
Principal & Founder

blocks.text: Aldo is an award-winning Senior Product Designer/Plastic Applications Specialist with 33 years of experience in a wide variety of new product development programs; mainly from concepts through to production. Prior to founding his own firm, Evolve Design Solutions Inc., in 2005, he spent 15 years as a consultant in product development working for two major design firms, where he spearheaded the plastic applications department and held the title of Design Engineering Director. Aldo has worked with many leading and reputable companies such as Black & Decker, Nortel Networks, Motorola , General Motors, Electrolux, Canada Post, MDS Nordion, Hydro-Quebec, C-MAC and CCM.

Aldo has substantial experience in 3D CAD modeling, mold filling analysis/simulation as well as in the development of injection molded components and plastic materials selection. He is an avid supporter of DFMA (Design for Manufacture and Assembly), CE (Concurrent Engineering), RP (Rapid Prototyping) and RT (Rapid Tooling) as well as mold filling analysis/simulation. He holds many utility and design patents and is currently a silver member of the Society of Plastics Engineers (SPE), senior member of the Society of Manufacturing Engineers (SME) as well as a professional member of the Industrial Designers Society of America (IDSA).

Aldo has published and presented many papers, was a guest speaker on the Discovery Channel as well as, on many occasions; has been a guest lecturer on Rapid Prototyping and Rapid Tooling at Carleton University, in Ottawa. He was appointed as a board member to the Moldflow IMUG (International Moldflow User Group) and was elected an honorary member of the board of directors of the SPE/PD3 (Product Design & Development) division. He has served, since 2003, as a member of the SME Injection Molding Technical Group and the SME Design for Plastics Technical Group. For 2005-2006, he has been appointed Chair of the SME Injection Molding Technical Group as well as member of the SME Engineering Materials and Applications (EMA) Steering Committee. Aldo received, in 1984, an Industrial Design Diploma and scholarships from Georgian College of Applied Arts and Technologies in Barrie, Ontario.

blocks.text: About Our Services
We look at product development differently

Evolve Design Solutions’ approach to product development is different. We believe that creating great products is an accomplishment, achieved through strategic partnerships with both clients and suppliers.

This collaborative process starts by looking at your vision of the project, and understanding the design challenges you face. We then draw upon the creative thinking, technical expertise, ability to combine form with function and the vast resources of our strategic partners, who are as committed as we are to your new product development project.
Treating product development as a partnerships program is a unique approach. It’s what sets apart Evolve Design Solutions, our created new products and our clients from the competition.

“Combining world-class product development services with the power
of strategic partnerships”

blocks.text: Project Management

We understand that to accomplish client expectations in a design program, a project requires planning and initial due diligence. We will define clear expectations and responsibilities and establish communication procedures and schedules. items.title: Smart AlertTM Remote Control Alerting System Designed by Evolve
paragraphs: Evolve has recently completed the world-class industrial design program for the remote control of the Unitron Smart AlertTM System, the first fully integrated hearing and alerting system that enables household alerts to communicate directly with hearing instruments. The system, developed in partnership with Bellman & Symfon of Sweden, a global leader in alerting technologies, brings together Unitron’s widely acclaimed remote control and advanced hearing instruments with proven home alerting detectors. The Smart AlertTM System wirelessly connects household detectors with the Smart Alert remote – the same remote used for hearing instrument functionality. When doorbell, telephone or smoke detectors sound, the Smart AlertTM System provides alerts through event-specific icons on the remote, the remote vibrates, and beep signals are sent directly to the hearing instruments. At night, when hearing instruments are not in use, the Smart Alert remote is placed in its nightstand charger, which connects to a bed shaker, so alerts are maintained around the clock.

items.title: Aldo Balatti to Chair SME Conference at NPE 2006
paragraphs: The Society of Manufacturing Engineers (SME) has appointed Aldo Balatti of Evolve Design Solutions, Ottawa, ON, Canada, as Chair and Moderator for two energizing technical sessions called Productivity Enhancements for Injection Molding. The conference, running alongside the National Plastics Exposition (NPE), entitled Managing Plastics Manufacturing: Strategies for Improved Productivity & Lean Integration will be held June 20-21, 2006 at McCormick Place, Chicago, IL. NPE is the premiere tradeshow serving the plastics industry. This will be the first time SME has participated in NPE and will sponsor its own conference, as well as assist in the development of SPI’s technical sessions.
